name: How much extra does a luxury finish add to a home extension?

mainEntity.name: How much extra does a luxury finish add to a home extension?
mainEntity.text: How much extra does a luxury finish add to a home extension?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury finishes can significantly change the total cost of a home extension because the upgrade is not just cosmetic. Premium cabinetry, natural stone, custom millwork, specialty lighting, wide-format tile, high-end plumbing fixtures, and custom windows all add material and labor costs. The more custom the design, the more coordination is required during installation, which can raise project management time as well. In the Los Angeles market, a standard addition and a luxury addition may look similar in size but differ dramatically in total price. Homeowners should decide early which finish categories matter most, because mixing luxury and standard-grade items strategically can keep the design high-end without overspending everywhere. The most expensive choices are usually the ones that affect multiple trades at once, such as custom kitchens or spa-like bathrooms. A good estimate should separate base construction cost from finish upgrades so the budget is easier to control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury finishes can add a substantial amount per square foot because they increase cabinetry, tile, fixtures, millwork, glazing, and labor costs. In Los Angeles, premium materials and custom details can move a project well above standard extension pricing.
